## audits

| Column | Type | Nullable | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| id | UUID | NO | PK, default `gen_random_uuid()` |
| project_id | UUID | NO | FK → projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE |
| user_id | UUID | NO | owner |
| screenshot_url | TEXT | NO | storage path or legacy URL |
| analysis | TEXT | YES | legacy plain-text analysis |
| ai_report | JSONB | YES | structured AI output |
| overall_score | INT | YES | denormalized from `ai_report.score` |
| selected_personas | JSONB | YES | array of `{name, description}` objects |
| screen_context | TEXT | YES | screen goal / purpose |
| user_data | TEXT | YES | real user metrics / drop-off evidence |
| flow_images | JSONB | YES | array of image paths for flow audits |
| context_images | JSONB | YES | array of context image paths |
| status | TEXT | NO | `pending | processing | completed | failed`; default `'completed'` |
| error_message | TEXT | YES | failure details |
| feedback_rating | SMALLINT | YES | user satisfaction 1–5 |
| feedback_comment | TEXT | YES | optional comment |
| follow_up_audit_id | UUID | YES | FK → audits(id) ON DELETE SET NULL; links to previous audit in re-audit chain |
| reaudit_explanation | TEXT | YES | AI-generated delta explanation (set once, reused) |
| source | TEXT | NO | `'app'` or `'plugin'`; default `'app'` |
| visible_in_app | BOOLEAN | NO | when false, audit is hidden from main UI; default `true` |
| created_at | TIMESTAMPTZ | NO | default `now()` |

**Foreign keys:** `project_id` → `projects(id)` ON DELETE CASCADE; `follow_up_audit_id` → `audits(id)` ON DELETE SET NULL
**RLS:** enabled — users can SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE only rows where `auth.uid() = user_id`

## profiles

| Column | Type | Nullable | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| id | UUID | NO | PK, default `gen_random_uuid()` |
| user_id | UUID | NO | UNIQUE, FK → auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE |
| figma_access_token | TEXT | YES | AES-GCM encrypted; column SELECT revoked from `authenticated` role — access only via Edge Functions |
| has_figma_token | BOOLEAN | NO | safe boolean flag for UI checks; default `false` |
| completed_tours | JSONB | NO | map of tour name → true; default `'{}'` |
| created_at | TIMESTAMPTZ | NO | default `now()` |
| updated_at | TIMESTAMPTZ | NO | default `now()`; auto-updated by trigger |

**Foreign keys:** `user_id` → `auth.users(id)` ON DELETE CASCADE
**RLS:** enabled — users can INSERT/UPDATE their own row; SELECT is via the `profiles_public` view only.
**View:** `profiles_public` (security_barrier + security_invoker) exposes `id, user_id, has_figma_token, created_at, updated_at` to `authenticated` role.
